title: PAP Supply Replenishment Program Enrollment and Activation Conditions
content:
## Clause 1 — the device served

An enrollment in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program serves a PAP device the patient is using. A Summit Ridge device qualifies while its device record (PAP Therapy Equipment) is trial active, rental active or patient owned. An outside device qualifies only with proof of ownership or prior coverage where the schedule requires proof for an outside device.

## Clause 2 — order, continued use and authorization

The supply order must be no older than the schedule's supply-order validity months and, where the schedule's proof-of-continued-use months are above 0, the latest proof of continued use, of the kind the schedule accepts, must be no older than that many months. Where the schedule requires a supplies prior authorization, an affirmed authorization no older than the schedule's prior-authorization validity months must be on file.

## Clause 3 — automatic shipment

Automatic shipment may be set on an enrollment only where the schedule allows automatic shipment, and only on the patient's own choice.

## Clause 4 — activation

An enrollment is activated only while the Summit Ridge device record it serves is trial active, rental active or patient owned. The status is read from the device record the enrollment serves, in the system, before activation.

| Status of the device record the enrollment serves | Activation |
|---|---|
| trial active | may proceed |
| rental active | may proceed |
| patient owned | may proceed |
| any other status | not activated |

## Points of judgement

- **Order age.** On a schedule whose order validity is 12 months, a supply order 11 months old meets Clause 2 and one 13 months old does not (hypothetical ages).
- **No proof needed.** Where the schedule's proof-of-continued-use months are 0, Clause 2 asks for no proof of continued use.
- **Automatic shipment.** On a schedule that does not allow automatic shipment, the enrollment carries no automatic shipment even if the patient asks for it; on a schedule that allows it, automatic shipment is set only when the patient chooses it.
- **Activation.** A Summit Ridge device record that is trial active, rental active or patient owned allows activation; a device record in any other status does not.
